heroHeadline: Xi Jinping to Attend New Delhi BRICS Summit in First India Visit in Seven Years
heroSubtitle: Chinese President Xi Jinping will travel to India for the BRICS Leaders' Summit, his first visit in seven years, as India-China border tensions ease ahead of the September 12-13 gathering. Bangladesh's PM Tarique Rahman was notably not invited, highlighting the geopolitical fault lines shaping the summit's guest list.
